instruction: Set up the Chrome extension from the zip archive at /home/user/Desktop/. Confirm the extension description is configured as 'Base Level Extension'.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get install unzip -y && unzip /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip -d /home/user/Desktop/ && rm /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip

metadata.explanation: This task verifies the extension description field in manifest.json. Expected description is 'Base Level Extension' as confirmed from the original manifest file.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete verification coverage: Instruction requires 'Set up the Chrome extension' but evaluator only checks if manifest.json has correct description field, not whether extension is actually installed/loaded in Chrome

Wrong state verification: Evaluator reads source manifest.json from extracted folder (/home/user/Desktop/helloExtension), not from Chrome's extension installation directory, so it verifies source file rather than successful extension setup
Missing verification: No check for whether extension is actually loaded, enabled, or visible in chrome://extensions/
Evaluator would pass even if extension installation failed, as long as the source manifest.json file exists with correct description
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Option 1: Simplify instruction to only verify manifest description (remove 'Set up' requirement) - change to: 'Confirm the extension manifest at /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension has description configured as Base Level Extension'
Option 2: Add verification that extension is actually installed in Chrome by checking chrome://extensions/ accessibility tree for the extension with matching description
Option 3: Add postconfig to navigate to chrome://extensions/ and add getter to verify extension appears there with correct description field
Option 4: Check Chrome's extension installation directory (e.g., ~/.config/google-chrome/Default/Extensions/) to verify extension was actually installed
